pages.text: Check the installed brass recipe: copper and zinc use a Basin, Mixer and fueled Blaze Burner. The quest checks a completed batch, not a loose ingot.

pages.text: Power a Mechanical Mixer above a Basin and supply recipe inputs. Automate compatible mixing and shapeless recipes; use the Basin filter for ambiguity.
